translation: When there comes God’s victory, and conquest

arabic: وَرَأَيۡتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدۡخُلُونَ فِي دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفۡوَاجٗا
translation: And you see the people entering God’s religion in multitudes

arabic: فَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا
translation: Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and seek His forgiveness. He is the Accepter of Repentance
